ov: صباح الخير يا زوجتي العزيزة، فيلم مصري، أُنتج في 17 مارس 1969، وهو من بطولة صلاح ذو الفقار ونيللي وإخراج عبد المنعم شكري.
plotEn: The two spouses, Hassan and Samia, who are happily married, and their lives are disturbed by some of Samia's mother's harassment, who dislikes Hassan and wants her daughter to leave him and marry her cousin who loved her from childhood. Then they have their first child and start trying to face problems in dealing with nannies and trying to hold on their jobs.
